raw.title: fix: decide xpath criteria by effective boolean value
raw.body:
fix: decide xpath criteria by effective boolean value

XPath success criteria whose expression returned a boolean or number
always passed: select_xpath stringified the typed result ("false", "0")
before the truthiness check, and any non-empty string is truthy.

XPathSelection now carries the effective boolean value, computed from
the typed XPath result via XPath 1.0 boolean coercion before
normalization, and the criterion decision uses it (Arazzo 1.1.0
S5.8.11.4.4 truth table, arm for arm). This also makes a matched
node-set with empty text content pass, per the "at least one node" arm.

Normalized value and match_count are unchanged, so outputs, Selector
Objects, and debugger watches keep their existing contract.

Negative tests cover every arm at unit, criterion, and engine level;
each fails against the pre-fix decision. Closes finding F1 in the
2026-08-22 rust-code-smell audit, recorded in the audit doc.
